title: Global sections of the derived internal Hom
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site whose underlying category is small and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$; let $D(\mathcal O)$ be the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of the abelian category of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $\Gamma(\mathcal C,-)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal O,-)$ the global sections functor. For $K\in D(\mathcal O)$ put $H^0(\mathcal C,K)=H^0(\Gamma(\mathcal C,\mathcal J^\bullet))$ for a K-injective complex $\mathcal J^\bullet$ [def-pur-kinjective-complex] representing $K$ (one exists by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]; the result does not depend on the choice up to canonical isomorphism, as two K-injective complexes representing $K$ are homotopy equivalent). Then for $L,M\in D(\mathcal O)$ there is a canonical isomorphism

$$
 H^0\bigl(\mathcal C,R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(L,M)\bigr)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O)}(L,M),
$$

with $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}$ the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom].

proof.text: Use the canonical independent-universe K-injective resolution functor and transformation. The derived internal Hom comparison computes the pullback along Q.op.prod Q as Q of Hom(L,I(M)). Apply the independent-universe complex-level hypercohomology comparison to obtain homotopy-category Hom(L,I(M)).

Use the additive bijection Qh.mapAddHom into a K-injective target. Transport along quotientCompQhIso and invert Q of the resolution transformation. Naturality of the resolution and of the quotient comparison proves pre/postcomposition naturality. Put the groups in a common universe using ULift.

Descend the natural isomorphism along the product localization using fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft.preimageIso. Remove ULift from its components to get additive equivalences. Apply its naturality square to ULift.up x for the required equation.

lean.statement:
theorem rhom_global_sectionsOfUniverses
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      ((sheafCompose J
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R))] :
    ∃ e : ∀ P : (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
        ((sheafCompose J
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)))ᵒᵖ ×
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
          ((sheafCompose J
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)),
      ((ringedSiteZerothHypercohomologyOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).obj
        ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).obj P)) ≃+ (P.1.unop ⟶ P.2),
      ∀ (P P' : (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
          ((sheafCompose J
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)))ᵒᵖ ×
          DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
            ((sheafCompose J
              (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)))
        (f : P ⟶ P')
        (x : (ringedSiteZerothHypercohomologyOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).obj
          ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).obj P)),
        e P' ((ringedSiteZerothHypercohomologyOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).map
          ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R).map f) x) =
            f.1.unop ≫ e P x ≫ f.2
